edges.reason: msg.sender is compared against the router and pair to authorise transfers, letting the caller influence the check.
onlyOwner gates openTrading on _owner == _msgSender().
manualswap requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
manualsend requires _msgSender() == _teamAddress.
setBots is owner-gated through onlyOwner.
delBot is owner-gated through onlyOwner.
setMaxTxPercent is owner-gated through onlyOwner.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the source of funds.
transferFrom decrements the caller's allowance, so msg.sender controls spending.
Cooldown enforcement compares cooldown[to] against block.timestamp and writes a future timestamp.
block.timestamp is passed as the router swap deadline.
block.timestamp is passed as the addLiquidityETH deadline.
_transfer performs the token->ETH swap through an external router call before sender/recipient balances are updated.
_transfer forwards ETH to team/marketing via external transfers before state settlement in _tokenTransfer.
After checks and swaps, _transfer delegates the actual balance mutation to _tokenTransfer.
swapTokensForEth invokes the external router swap.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the team address.
sendETHToFee performs a raw ETH transfer to the marketing address.
The external router swap can re-enter the transfer path while balances are still stale.
ETH transfer to a contract team address can trigger a receive/fallback that re-enters _transfer.
ETH transfer to a contract marketing address can re-enter the transfer path.
manualswap swaps the full contract token balance.
manualsend distributes the contract ETH balance.
openTrading adds ETH liquidity through the external router.
openTrading creates the pair and grants an unlimited router approval.
openTrading writes the Uniswap router address.
openTrading stores the created pair address.
openTrading sets tradingOpen to true.
openTrading enables automatic swapping.
openTrading enables cooldown restrictions.
openTrading lowers the maximum transaction amount.
_maxTxAmount is recomputed with multiplication and division on owner input.
Public transfer routes into _transfer.
transferFrom routes into _transfer before adjusting allowance.
approve delegates allowance writing to _approve.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_tokenTransfer calls the standard reflection transfer.
_transferStandard subtracts and adds reflection balances.
_transferStandard credits the team fee.
_transferStandard reflects the tax fee.
_takeTeam credits reflections to the contract address.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by the fee reflections.
tokenFromReflection derives the current rate.
tokenFromReflection reads reflection balances for conversion.
_transfer blocks senders/recipients flagged in bots.
_transfer reads and writes per-address cooldown timestamps.
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount.
_transfer checks the inSwap guard before swapping.
_transfer only auto-swaps when swapEnabled is true.
_transfer applies caller restrictions only when cooldownEnabled is true.
_transfer whitelists the router address in the cooldown checks.
_transfer whitelists the pair address and detects buys from it.
_transfer decides takeFee from the fee-exclusion mapping.
_tokenTransfer may zero and restore _taxFee for fee-free transfers.
_tokenTransfer may zero and restore _teamFee for fee-free transfers.
Caller amount flows into the transfer checks and swaps.
from is validated and used for all balance logic.
to is validated and used for cooldown and balance logic.
recipient is forwarded to _transfer by the public transfer function.
sender is the account debited in transferFrom.
maxTxPercent scales the new transaction limit.
bots_ entries are written into the blocklist mapping.
notbot is cleared from the blocklist mapping.
tokenAmount is the amount approved and swapped for ETH.
Constructor team address determines who receives the raw ETH transfer.
Cached contract token balance decides the swap size.
Cached contract ETH balance decides the fee distribution.
takeFee selects the fee-bearing transfer path.
path defines the router swap route.
currentRate is used to convert reflections to tokens.
rAmount is subtracted from the sender's reflection balance.

normalization_plan.reason: Caller-supplied amount is only meaningful when validating and applying the internal transfer.
The source address parameter exists solely to drive the internal transfer.
The destination address parameter exists solely to drive the internal transfer.
Public transfer recipient is immediately forwarded into the transfer path.
Debited account parameter belongs to the transferFrom entry point.
Owner percentage input only exists to recompute the transaction limit.
Batch blocklist array is consumed only by the blocklisting loop.
Address parameter is consumed only to clear a blocklist entry.
Swap size parameter is fully absorbed by the router swap routine.
Constructor team address becomes the recipient of the team ETH transfer.
Local cache drives the automatic swap decision inside _transfer.
Local cache drives the ETH distribution decision inside _transfer.
Fee flag determines fee removal/restoration in the token transfer wrapper.
Swap route array is local to the token-to-ETH swap.
Rate cache is produced by the reflection rate helper.
Reflection amount is local to the balance mutation routine.
